$schema.description: This schema's URL, for editors. Ignored.

trigger.description: auto reviews every PR; requested only PRs that ask.

team.description: Team slug whose review request counts as an ask.

profile.description: A provider profile the deployment defines.

model.description: A model the profile allows; omit for its default.

label.description: The label that makes a PR a plan review.

personas.description: Plan-mode personas: a comma or space separated list, or all. Shipped: adversarial, good_friend, helland, red_team, sage, sme, user.
Code-mode personas: a comma or space separated list, or all. Shipped: adversarial, good_friend, helland, red_team, sage, sme, user.

max_concurrent_personas.description: A PR's personas at once; 0 is all.

cap.description: Automatic rounds before an explicit ask is needed.
